open_findings.title: The first owner song after a confirmed switch away from a guest device is still recorded as guest
open_findings.preconditions: One configured party device and a distinct unconfigured owner phone. No manual guest mode.
reproduction: Start station on party device and observe it after 10 seconds; guest.active is true.
Start a different single song on the owner phone; after 10 seconds force a real HubCore sync. Provider observation reports the owner device and guest.active becomes false.
Listen another 35 seconds, skip in FakeSpotify, and sync history. Query plays for that owner track.
open_findings.expected: The 45-second owner song is retained as ignored=0 and participates in owner listening memory; the observation already confirmed a different unconfigured device.
open_findings.actual: The history row exists with ignored=1. Automatic closure writes tail=null, but noteGuestLast treats the observed owner song as the old manual-style guest tail with owner=0. The later listing is ignored before tail=null can exclude it.
open_findings.impact: Observed owner music silently disappears from listening memory/consumption after a core device-return journey. Violates NN-02/NN-08 and UI copy that music counts again after seeing another device.

evidence.test: test/hub/pr21-independent.test.ts (independent: owner short play after confirmed device transition counts)
evidence.command: npm test -- test/hub/pr21-independent.test.ts -t 'owner short play after confirmed device transition'
evidence.control: Identical trace without configuring guest devices passes on exact head and archived exact baseline; /tmp/pr21-independent-baseline.log.

open_findings.repair_direction: Represent a confirmed automatic-device exit separately from uncertain manual/timed guest tails so noteGuestLast cannot adopt an observed distinct owner song. Preserve actual previous guest history and manual guest semantics.
required_regressions: Distinct owner track starts before first phone observation, is observed at 10s, and is skipped after another 35s: ignored=0 and memory updated.
Same scenario across HubCore eviction, ordinary/forced history read order, paused/no-player closure, and player 429 with successful history fallback.
Manual and timed guest-tail, private listening, unfinished queue checkpoint, and native/account isolation tests remain green.

open_findings.title: A concurrently listed owner device with a distinct ID is automatically treated as the selected guest device when names collide
open_findings.preconditions: Two concurrently listed devices have different IDs and the same Spotify name (e.g. iPhone). Only the second device is selected as always guest.
reproduction: Keep existing phone ID active. Add second visible device ID party with exactly the existing phone name.
Configure only party as a guest device. Start station on the phone and observe playback.
open_findings.expected: The explicitly unselected owner phone remains owner playback; the user can select the two devices independently.
open_findings.actual: Current player still has phone.id, but guest.active=true because matching uses id OR name. UI also hides the unselected same-name device, preventing separate settings.
open_findings.impact: A plausible Spotify name collision suppresses all owner history/memory on the wrong device, even while both stable IDs are simultaneously available.
open_findings.qualification: Name matching for legitimately rotated device IDs is an intended feature. This reproduction instead uses two distinct IDs both still present in the same device list; no ID rotation occurred.

evidence.test: test/hub/pr21-independent.test.ts (independent: a different current device id with the same name is not the configured guest device)

open_findings.repair_direction: Use an identity/ambiguity policy that preserves explicit distinct IDs, and allow independent rows for same-name devices. Only use name recovery when identity rotation can be established without merging concurrently distinct devices.
required_regressions: Concurrent same-name different IDs stay independently configurable and owner ID counts.
Single unambiguous genuine rotated-ID recovery still follows the explicitly chosen policy.

non_blocking_observations.title: Removing the final configured guest device leaves an existing automatic period active
non_blocking_observations.actual: setGuestDevices([]) changes only guest_devices; state remains guest.active=true until a successful player read or the 15-minute hold expires. UI announces the device counts again immediately.
non_blocking_observations.evidence: Third exploratory assertion in test/hub/pr21-independent.test.ts fails. Not promoted to a blocker because intended timing policy is not explicit.
